english.title: Fail to preserve documents as required under article 238 of the Air Navigation Order 2016
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[first operator]_
(B)_[personal representative of the first operator]_

of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), failed to deliver to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), another person who had become the operator of the aircraft, on demand
(C)_[the national airworthiness review certificate and release to service]_
(D)_[the log books]_
(E)_[the weight schedule]_
(F)_[a record made by a flight data recorder and preserved in accordance with article 233(2) and 234(2) of the Air Navigation Order 2016]_

which was

(G)_[in force]_
(H)_[required to be preserved]_

for that aircraft
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 238(4) and 265(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being the first operator or his personal representative of an aircraft,
failed to deliver to another person who had become the operator of the aircraft, on demand the national airworthiness review certificate and release to service OR the log books OR the weight schedule
OR a record made by a flight data recorder and preserved in accordance with article 233(2) and 234(2) of the Order
which was in force or required to be preserved for that aircraft.
